title: Recording: Rock Show by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

An overdub session for the Wings song ‘Rock Show’ took place on 5 February 1975.

The backing track had been recorded on 27 January, with overdubs added the following day.

During this session, Jimmy McCulloch recorded a dobro part, and Denny Laine double-tracked his electric guitar lines.
